name: Caíntigern

attributes.attribute: a minor woman of Irish mythology

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Caíntigern is a figure in Irish mythology. She is a goddess or a heroine of minor rank. She mothered the king Mongán, who ruled with magic. Mongán's father was Manannán mac Lir, the Irish sea god.

okr.objective: Caíntigern is a minor goddess and mother of the magical king Mongán.
